title: PISA screening protocol - A protocol for the selection of intracellular antibodies against post-translational modifications of native proteins
protocol: Grow L40 yeast strain at 30°C in YPD medium.
Transform L40 yeast strain with plasmid bearing TRP1 or LEU2 genes.
Grow transformed yeast on appropriate selective medium lacking either Trp or Leu, or both for co-transformations.
Preserve yeast strains by storing Glycerol Stocks (GS) at -80°C.
Streak yeast from GS onto fresh plates 3 days before usage.
Synthesize full-length constructs of PISA tethered catalysis baits.
Transform bait plasmid into yeast to obtain a stable line.
Amplify full-length constructs using PCR to append them to pMICBD1.
Extract truncated baits for the control panel.
Incorporate final constructs in pMICBD1 plasmid by endonuclease cut/ligation.
Alternatively, incorporate final constructs in pMICBD1 plasmid by Gibson Assembly.
Join different domains with overlap PCR using Accustar HF polymerase.
Exploit linkers between LexA and the antigen to allow better catalysis.
Exploit linkers between the antigen and the enzyme to minimize degradation.
Inoculate few colonies of L40 in 50 ml of YPD and incubate for 16-18 hr with shaking at 230 rpm at 30°C.
Dilute the overnight culture to OD600=0.2-0.3 in 300 ml of YPD prewarmed to 30°C.
Grow diluted culture at 30°C for 3 hours with shaking (230 rpm) until OD600=0.5-0.7.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation (1000 g for 5 min) at room temperature, discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 50 ml of H2O.
Centrifuge the cells again as before, decant the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 ml of freshly prepared 1X TE/LiAc (10 mM TE, 0.1 M LiAc).
Mix 0.1 μg of bait vector construct with yeast cells.
Add 0.6 ml of sterile PEG/TE/LiAc to the tube and vortex to mix.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 30°C with shaking (230 rpm).
Add 70 μl of DMSO, mix gently by inversion, and heat shock for 15 min in a 42°C water bath.
Chill cells on ice.
Pellet cells by centrifugation (20 sec at maximum speed).
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in 0.5 ml of sterile 1X TE.
Spread 100 μl for single transformation on each 100 mm plate (SD-Trp).
Incubate the plates in a static incubator at 30°C.
Pick single colonies from transformation plates and restreak them onto fresh SD-Trp plates.
Create glycerol stock from master plates as soon as possible.
Culture a single colony from the master plate in 10ml of liquid SD–W medium O/N.
Dilute the overnight culture with YPD to OD600=0.3 and grow until OD600=0.6.
Spin down the cells at 1000 g for 5min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend in 10ml of sterile distilled water.
Spin down again for 5min, 1000 g.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend in T.E.1x with protease inhibitors.
Add 1g of Sigma Glass Beads to the cells on ice.
Vortex the sample 1 min, put it on ice.
Repeat vortexing four times.
Transfer all the supernatant you can take (usually 200-300 μl) to a 1.5ml eppendorf tube and add 25 μl of Triton-X-100 20%.
Vortex the sample for 30 seconds.
Spin down for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new eppendorf tube.
Quantify the sample with the Bradford method.
Boil the samples for 5 minutes.
Load the boiled samples on an SDS-PAGE gel.
Perform Western blot using anti-lexA antibody and/or anti-tag antibody.
Use anti-PTM-antigen antibody in the Western blot (specific or pan-reactive).
Submit PT modified baits to Mass Spectrometry analysis for identification and confirmation of specific modifications.
Plate stable bait line on SD-WH plates to look for growth in absence of histidine.
Add 3-amino-1,2,4-triazole (3-AT) to SD-WH medium if yeast grows without histidine.
Prepare SD-WH plates with increasing concentrations of 3-AT from 1.25 mM to 100 mM.
Spot yeast at several dilutions on the SD-WH + 3-AT plates, typically from 1:1 to 1:10,000.
Determine the minimum required concentration of 3-AT that inhibits unspecific growth.
Use the fine-tuned 3-AT concentration to prepare screening plates for PISA selection.
Recover Baits derived from Glycerol Stocks onto 3 fresh SD–W plates (30°C for 3 days).
Grow L40 yeast containing bait plasmid in 50 ml of SD-W medium overnight at 30°C at 230 rpm shaking.
Inoculate 150 ml of SD-W with an aliquot of the overnight culture to place the 150 ml culture in logarithmic phase the next day.
Transfer enough overnight culture into 1 liter of prewarmed YPAD medium to produce an OD600 = 0.3.
Grow at 30°C for 3 hours until OD=0.6.
Centrifuge the cells at 1500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Wash pellet in 500 ml of 10mM TE then centrifuge again the cells at 1500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Resuspend pellet in 20 ml 10mM TE, 0.1M LiAc and transfer to a new flask.
Add 500 μg of a yeast scFv library DNA and 10 mg of salmon sperm carrier DNA and mix well.
Add 140 ml of 40% PEG 3350, 10mM TE, 0.1M LiAc; mix and incubate for 30 min at 30°C with gently shaking.
Add 17.6 ml of DMSO; swirl to mix.
Heat shock for 15 minutes at 42°C in a water bath, swirling occasionally to mix.
Rapidly cool cells at room temperature by diluting with 400 ml YPA in a water bath.
Pellet cells by centrifugation and wash with 500 ml YPA.
After centrifugation resuspend pellet in 1 l of prewarmed YPAD.
Incubate for 1 hour at 30°C with gently shaking.
Pellet cells from 1 ml; resuspend in 1 ml SD-WL; spread 100 μl of a 1:1000, 1:100, 1: 10 dilutions for transformation efficiency controls.
Pellet cells from the remaining culture.
Wash pellet with 500 ml SD-WL.
Resuspend in 1 liter of prewarmed SD-WL and incubate overnight at 30°C with gentle shaking.
Pellet cells and wash twice with 500 ml of SD-WHL.
Resuspend final pellet in 10 ml of SD-WHL by carefully removing the supernatant using a pipette.
Spread dilutions of the total on SD-WL plates to compare with the number of primary transformants for calculating doublings and his+ colonies.
Spread part of the remaining transformation suspension on SD-WHL plate. Store cotransformed yeasts in 30% glycerol/SD-WHL at -80°C.
Incubate the plates in a static incubator at 30°C.
Pick clones grown after 4-7 days of incubation at 30°C from screening plates and restreak onto fresh SD–WHL plates.
Make a replica with the same tip onto SD–WL plates for β-Galactosidase filter assay preparation.
Patch yeast colonies to a nitrocellulose filter circle from a SD-WL replication plate.
Lift filter and place colony side up on a pre-cooled aluminum boat floating upon liquid nitrogen.
Immerse boat and filter for 5 seconds after 20 seconds.
Allow the filter to come to room temperature.
Place the filter on top of Whatman qualitative filter paper prewet in Z-buffer/X-Gal/BMe solution.
Incubate the filter for up to 5 hours.
Grow O/N yeasts bearing bait/prey couples in SD-WL medium.
Transfer enough overnight culture into YPD to achieve an OD600 = 0.3.
Grow cultures at 30°C until OD600=0.6.
Pellet cells at 3000 g for 5 min and perform 3 freeze/thaw cycles (liquid nitrogen to 37°C thermoblock).
Incubate the pellet with Lyticase solution for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Spin the solution for 15 minutes at 16,000 g at 4°C and transfer supernatant to a new tube.
Perform a Bradford assay for quantification.
Dilute 25 µg of extract in Z-buffer to a final volume of 100 µl in a 96-well plate.
Add an equal volume of Z-buffer/Xgal/BMe to each sample and incubate at 37°C for 2 hours to overnight, until proper color development.
Read plates at 595nm.
Pellet 3-5 ml of O/N culture in SD-L medium for 2 sec at maximum speed.
Resuspend pellet in 250 μl of Yeast Lysis Solution.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add 250 μl of Cell Resuspension Solution.
Add 250 μl of Cell Lysis Solution to each sample.
Invert 4 times to mix.
Add 10 μl of Alkaline Protease Solution.
Invert 4 times to mix.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 350 μl of Neutralization Solution.
Invert 4 times to mix.
Centrifuge at top speed for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Insert Spin Column into Collection Tube.
Decant cleared lysate into Spin Column.
Centrifuge at top speed for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard flowthrough and reinsert column into Collection Tube.
Add 750 μl of Wash Solution.
Centrifuge at top speed for 1 minute.
Discard flowthrough and reinsert column into Collection Tube.
Repeat Step with 250 μl of Wash Solution.
Centrifuge at top speed for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer Spin Column to a sterile 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
If the Spin Column has Column Wash Solution associated with it, centrifuge again for 1 minute at top speed and transfer to a new, sterile 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 50 μl of Nuclease-Free Water to the Spin Column.
Centrifuge at top speed for 1 minute at room temperature.
Transform primary screening yeast clone candidates into yeast harboring the screening bait.
Confirm positivity in secondary test for those who show double positive results (His+/LacZ+).
Transform confirmed positives into yeast cells containing each control bait from the control panel.
Extract plasmid DNA from yeast and transform E. coli Ca++ competent cells with 1-10 µl of extracted plasmid DNA.
Isolate plasmid DNA from bacteria using the same Minipreps DNA Purification System used previously.
Sequence insert or compare the E.coli fingerprint digestion patterns to that obtained from the original yeast colony.
Prepare plasmids for transformation back into yeast for secondary screening with the screening bait.
Transform plasmids in yeast again following the Yeast LiAc transformation (small-scale) protocol.
